patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring oversized, layered typography and a central graphic element, transitioning to a consistent grid of portfolio cards below.
Juxtaposition of highly stylized display fonts, including pixelated and elegant script styles, with clean, legible sans-serifs for body and UI text.
A muted, warm background palette (light beige/pink) is contrasted with vibrant, sometimes neon-like, accent colors (bright pink, olive green, purple) and occasional dark-mode sections.
Large, decorative text elements in the hero section animate with a parallax effect, sliding or scaling into view as the user scrolls down the page.
The page is structured with a full-bleed, visually rich hero, followed by a dense, responsive grid of portfolio project cards, and a distinct 'View Archives' call-to-action section.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to create a dynamic parallax effect for oversized text elements, revealing them with a staggered motion as the user scrolls. Key header elements remain sticky at the top of the viewport.
The hero section employs a full-bleed design with multiple layers of large, stylized typography and a central graphic, creating a visually impactful and deep composition.
Portfolio items are presented in a responsive grid, each card featuring a project image and minimal descriptive text, maintaining a clean and focused presentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, decorative display headings (up to ~8x body text) with a mix of pixelated, script, and bold serif styles, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body and UI text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, primarily on interactive elements and card corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within the portfolio grid items.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of retro-futuristic pixel art typography with elegant script fonts and bold, modern layouts creates a unique, eclectic, and highly artistic brand identity. The use of large, animating decorative text as a primary visual element is particularly striking and memorable.
